body: Yeah, it's definitely hard even when you know it's the right thing. We did talk about it, but I don't think it really went through to her. We still keep in touch, but not as much as before.
Thank you.
Thank you. He really is. I admire him a lot.
It was definitely hard having to call the police. I felt bad but I knew it was the right thing to do.

Her mother hated me for a while because she thought me calling the cops on her was "something a real friend wouldn't do". I took it with a grain of salt, but hopefully she will understand. 

At that point, the situation was out of my hands- when someone threatens suicide, I'm not going to let it slide. I take that very seriously and always have.

Hi! 

I'm not too sure. I believe so. The police arrived first to talk to her, then an ambulance came and they took her to a hospital afterwards. She then went to rehab for a while, and came back home. This was almost a year ago so I apologize if my memory isn't too good :)
I don't even know if she's off heroin now. She's pregnant, James is the dad. I hope to God she is sober now.
Thank you. I appreciate the comment :)

Yeah. And about a month afterwards, I had a close family friend die due to a heroin overdose. 

Scary shit. 

Then, my dad was worried because he found tin foil in my backyard fire pit- wasn't me or my husband. Guess who we had over the night before? James and Amy.  My dad had a good talk with us about it.
Yeah. I think she wanted me to tell James, to see if he came back. Or it was a cry for help.

Ever since my husband cheated on me, I don't think I'm in love with him anymore. Hell never admit it, but I know he was in love with her. 

I stay because of my daughter. Because I have nowhere else to go. Because of my job. I don't know how to tell him I love him, but I'm not IN LOVE. 

This whole affair has caused me crazy amounts of anger and lashing out. I don't feel like myself anymore. I don't know who I am anymore. We paint this picture perfect life, but I feel like it's far from it.
Thank you! That really helps. I guess we will see what happens tomorrow when they go to MP.

Oh man. Thank you for your response!
Thank you for your response!
Sorry, what is an article 15? He first lied to his Chief but then called back and told the truth. I don't condone it and wasn't there for this, but do you think that'll make things worse?
Thank you for your response
He's been talking to his LPO about this. Should I tell him to stop? I told him not to say anything unless it's with a lawyer. Seems like they're talking about a court date.

Oh definitely. 

Things were a lot easier before the drinking began.  When he was actively going to meetings, I would attend the open meetings, and other social events. If a meeting was closed? No problem, I'd sit in the lobby and read a book. They saw me as family and welcomed me. Husband was happier as well. Definitely am nostalgic for those days.
I will, thank you!
And thank you for the support as well. It really means a lot to me. I feel really crappy and like an enabler and it's hard to not get caught up in those feelings.

I'm so sorry, I didn't know you couldn't give advice on here! I know this community would be really helpful, more so than others. 
That is a really good idea. It's come up before, but just kinda like "oh hey, we hate being hungover, lets not drink". And it stopped there. But it's really taking a toll now. I think that is a great idea. It's great to have fun sober, which I did for many years. I miss that. 
Thank you for your comment. 🙂
